GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 676.3 (25 Jul 47) CCS
(SCAPIN - 1603/1)
APO 500
25 July 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Reactivation of the Coastal Radio Service of the Japanese Ministry of Communications to Handle Ship-Shore Traffic for Allied Merchant Shipping.
1. This is amendment number one (1) to Memorandum to the Japanese Government, file AG 676.3 (5 Apr 47) CCS, (SCAPIN-1603), dated 5 April 1947, subject same as above.
2. The Ministry of Communications will extend the services of the Japanese coastal radio stations to supply ship-shore radio communications to United States Army Transports. Acceptable messages, rates, accounting procedures and settlement of accounts applicable to messages sent to and received from United States Army Transports are set forth in Inclosure 1 to this memorandum.
3. The Ministry of Communications will further extend the services of the Japanese coastal radio stations to include full rate prepaid messages between accredited personnel of the British Commonwealth on board ships of British registry and British Occupational personnel in Japan, as set forth in Inclosure 3 to this memorandum.
4. Inclosures 1, 2 and 3 to the original SCAPIN 1603 are corrected and brought up to date, and attached, hereto, as Inclosures 2, 3 and 4 to this memorandum.
5. Direct communications between Civil Communications Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers and the Ministry of Communications, within the scope of this memorandum, are authorized.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R. M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
